maddeler.e:
استمنيت (form X)
# اِسْتَمْنَيْتُ (istamnaytu) /is.tam.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
# اِسْتَمْنَيْتَ (istamnayta) /is.tam.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
# اِسْتَمْنَيْتِ (istamnayti) /is.tam.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمْنَى (istamnā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
